capabilities: Log a study Pomodoro as a checklist line in today's daily note
Pick a book from a study desk and auto-fill the start page
Update daily frontmatter with Pomodoro count, pages read and study minutes
Show day, week, month and total reports with streaks and a heatmap
Delete a mistaken entry and restore the book's start page and desk state
disambiguation: Not a Pomodoro timer; it records completed study Pomodoros and reports on them.
extras: Persian/RTL interface; no telemetry, network requests or eval; all data stays local in the vault; MIT licensed.
problem: Study sessions are tedious to record by hand: page numbers, book progress and daily totals all have to be written into the daily note manually.

summary: Persian RTL form that logs study Pomodoros into the daily note, tracking books, pages read, streaks and reports.
